public.text: The heading uses “Metadata registries,” while the listed components include the Lifelong Health Record, Terminology Service, and Logical Information Model Repository. These are not all metadata registries. The terminology may therefore misrepresent the scope of the layer.
public.suggestedRevision: Rename the layer consistently as the foundational shared data and semantic layer, with “core metadata registries” as one category within it.
